'''''Nature Computational Science''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published monthly by [[Nature Portfolio]]. Established in 2021,<ref name="cassi">{{Citation |last= |first= |year= |title=Nature Computational Science (NCSACD; 2662-8457) |publication-place= |page= |url= |via=[[Chemical Abstracts Service|CASSI]]}}</ref> it covers research on the development and use of [[Computational science|computational techniques]] and mathematical models.<ref name="aims">{{cite web |title=Nature Computational Science: Aims & Scope |url=https://www.nature.com/natcomputsci/aims |website=nature.com |access-date=December 11, 2025}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief]] is Fernando Chirigati.<ref name="editors">{{cite web |title=Nature Computational Science: About the Editors |url=https://www.nature.com/natcomputsci/editors |website=nature.com |access-date=December 11, 2025}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[Current Contents]]/Engineering, Computing & Technology<ref name=ISI/>
*Current Contents/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI/>
*[[Ei Compendex]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[MEDLINE]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title= Nature Computational Science |issn= 2662-8457 |access-date=December 11, 2025}}</ref>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=November 25, 2025}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR/>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 18.3.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter= Nature Computational Science |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
